digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler live harness, DC data center adapter, jira family identity resolution
propositions: An issue created in a real Data Center instance must appear in the local store after an inbound reconciliation pass, and this must be proven against a copy of the production ticket store, not an empty one.
A local ticket edit must appear on the corresponding Data Center issue after an outbound pass, with the change persisting and idempotent on repeated passes.
The reconciler must be isolated from production Jira by running against a scrubbed store copy with no git remotes, no production Jira bindings, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off enforced independently.
All 28 DC mutation round-trips (14 inbound + 14 outbound directions) must be individually asserted with oracle reads proving the data reached the remote side, not merely that the pass exited 0.

Silent failures and swallowed exceptions on Data Center must be prevented through discriminating test oracles that cannot pass vacuously, including cases where the Cloud adapter has a translation that the DC adapter lacks (e.g., status transition, assignee identity minting, link removal, parent detach).

Pagination truncation must be observable and prevented by seeding beyond the effective server page size and asserting full recovery, since the inbound fetch is eventually consistent and multiple defects of this class have shipped undetected.
